answer: Each agent locks tokens plus a reputation record; new identities start at zero and must earn trust through completed tasks. One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted identity bonds tied to verifiable work history. Attackers must fund every fake identity and sustain it across a long horizon before voting power matures. Cheap throwaway accounts fail, since a single zephyr of doubt about provenance triggers peer review on the terrace of public attestations, slashing the bond.
